text: The supplier shall host all citizen data within UK data centres and shall not replicate or back up that data outside the United Kingdom.
The supplier shall hold a current ISO/IEC 27001 certificate covering the services in scope, and shall maintain it for the term of the contract.
The solution shall meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA for all citizen-facing screens, evidenced by an independent accessibility audit before go-live.
The supplier shall provide a service availability of at least 99.9% measured monthly, with service credits payable where availability falls below that level.
The supplier shall notify the Authority of any personal data breach within 24 hours of becoming aware of it.
On expiry or termination the supplier shall export all Authority data in an open, documented, machine-readable format at no additional charge.
The supplier shall provide a named service delivery manager and a documented escalation path with response targets for P1 incidents.
The solution shall integrate with the Authority's existing GOV.UK Notify account for outbound email and SMS notifications.
The supplier shall provide an open, documented REST API permitting the Authority to extract case data on demand.
The supplier shall deliver role-based training for up to 200 Authority staff, including recorded sessions retained for the contract term.
All supplier personnel with access to citizen data shall hold a current Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance.
The supplier shall publish a roadmap of planned product changes at least one quarter in advance and shall consult the Authority on breaking changes.
The supplier shall carry out an independent penetration test annually and share the full report and remediation plan with the Authority.
The solution shall support Welsh-language content for all citizen-facing screens and correspondence.
